issue: Global constant P=65521 was shadowed by later function definition P(w) for Parikh profile, causing TypeError at `% P` before rank computation.
impact_on_theorem_numbers: None. The theorem ranks were generated by separate working scripts and compiled C++ rank calculations. The packaged replay itself was broken.
fix: Renamed prime constant to PRIME and Parikh helper to parikh; reran from a clean unzip workspace.
lesson: Artifact/replay correctness must be audited separately from theorem correctness.
